{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the repulsorlift transport|the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury starships]]}}
[[File:Sailbarge-Chron.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Khetanna'', Jabba the Hutt's modified luxury sail barge]]
{{Quote|A Hutt without a sail barge is like a smoke moth without wings.|Translated from the Huttese|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>}}
A '''sail barge''' was a form of large, planetary [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] transport that was commonly used as pleasurecraft by members of underworld cartels, including many [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]]. Sail barges could operate over a variety of terrain, including water, sand and snow. One of the most famous models of sail barge was the [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian]] [[Luxury-class sail barge|Luxury sail barge]]. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] owned one of these barges, which he named [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']].
